## Use

Read [shared theme guidance](../GUIDANCE.md) before using this reference.
Use this file with one selected slug from [CATALOG.md](../CATALOG.md).

## Brand

Cosmic user-interface design is a futuristic, science-fiction style with dark
themes, vibrant neon accents, and immersive spatial elements.

## Style foundations

- Visual style: playful, premium
- Typography scale: 12/14/16/20/24/32 | Fonts: primary=Audiowide,
  display=Audiowide, mono=JetBrains Mono | weights=400
- Color palette: primary, neutral, success, warning, danger | Tokens:
  primary=#3B82F6, secondary=#8B5CF6, success=#16A34A, warning=#D97706,
  danger=#DC2626, surface=#FFFFFF, text=#111827
- Spacing scale: 4/8/12/16/24/32

## Copy tone

- Tone: concise, confident, helpful.

## Design intent

Futuristic sci-fi aesthetic with dark themes, vibrant neon accents, and
immersive spatial elements.
